Bundled mpv player
==================

HerdPlayer includes an unmodified Windows build of mpv as a separate executable.
HerdPlayer launches it as a child process and communicates through mpv's JSON IPC.

mpv version: v0.41.0-1050-ge76a35ec9
mpv commit: e76a35ec95
FFmpeg commit: b894a6f7c
Build date: 2026-09-20
Build provider: shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake
Build archive: mpv-x86_64-20260920-git-e76a35ec95.7z
Archive SHA-256: 0d4218b6c8da447040cfcb9c9423bdaacf7a5295360de1c6c9a94e5283a6d1fb
